sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emili.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Denmark.
Denmark is a small and beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Denmark?
Denmark is in Northern Europe.
It is part of Scandinavia.
It is close to Sweden, Germany and Norway.
Denmark is made of a big peninsula and many small islands.
It is surrounded by the North Sea and the Baltic Sea.
There are many bridges that connect the islands.
What is the capital city of Denmark?
The capital city is Copenhagen.
It is the biggest city in Denmark.
Many people live there.
Copenhagen is on the island of Zealand.
Copenhagen is modern and clean.
It has bikes, parks and colorful houses.
Many people ride bicycles every day.
How many people live in Denmark?
About 6 million people live in Denmark.
Most people live in cities and towns.
Copenhagen is the biggest city, but there are others like Aarhus, Odin's and Alborg.
Denmark is not very big, but it is very organized and peaceful.
What language do people speak in Denmark?
People speak Danish in Denmark.
Danish is the official language.
It is a Germanic language like English and German.
Many people in Denmark also speak English very well.
Children learn English at school, so visitors can speak English easily in Denmark.
What is the weather like in Denmark?
Denmark has four seasons.
Spring, summer, autumn and winter.
The winters are cold, windy and dark.
There is not much sunlight.
In summer, the weather is mild and cool.
It is not very hot, but the days are long and sunny.
People like to go outside in the summer.
They go to the beach or ride bikes in the city.
What does Denmark look like?
Denmark is flat.
There are no big mountains.
There are many fields, forests and coasts.
There are also many islands, over 400 islands.
Only some islands have people living on them.
Denmark is very green and clean.
What animals live in Denmark?
There are many animals in Denmark.
You can see deer, foxes, hairs and many birds.
There are also animals in the sea, like seals and poor voices.
People care about animals and nature in Denmark.
There are many parks and protected areas.
What do people eat in Denmark?
Danish food is simple and tasty.
One popular food is smera bread.
It is an open sandwich with bread, butter and different toppings
like fish, meat or eggs.
People eat fish, potatoes and rye bread.
They also eat soups and meat dishes.
In Denmark, people eat many vegetables too.
For dessert, they enjoy pastries.
Danish pastries are famous around the world.
They are sweet and soft, with fruit or cream.
What is life like in Denmark?
Life in Denmark is calm and organized.
People are friendly and polite.
Family and friends are important.
People often meet for coffee or dinner.
Many people ride bicycles every day.
Even in winter, you can see people on bikes.
Children go to school and adults work during the week.
On weekends, people relax, go for walks or visit family.
The Danish word he get is very famous.
He gain means a feeling of comfort, warmth and togetherness.
People like candles, drink tea and enjoy quiet time at home.
Some fun facts about Denmark.
Denmark has a queen.
Her name is Queen Margreta II.
Denmark is part of the European Union, but it uses the Danish crone, not the Euro.
The lego toy was invented in Denmark.
Denmark is often called one of the happiest countries in the world.
The flag of Denmark is red and white.
It is called the Danabrog.
It is one of the oldest flags in the world.
Now you know many things about Denmark.
You know where it is.
You know the capital city, the language and the food.
You learned about the weather, animals and life in Denmark.
Great job!
I am Emily.
Goodbye!
